title: Far Lands Traveler: Order of the Stone
description: Far Lands Traveler: Order of the Stone is a stripped-down version of the Far Lands themed adventure mod Far Lands Traveler.
body:
![Enchanted Book Room in the Laboratory of the Order of the Stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf58017b0b4a29a4841f95f3d4ae4a5dbd0d5de8_0.webp)
Far Lands Traveler: Order of the Stone is a stripped-down version of the Far Lands themed adventure mod Far Lands Traveler.

The purpose of creating this mod is to adapt to the Withestorm mod, so only the content related to the Far Lands and the Laboratory of the Order of the Stone from the original mod has been retained, and the rest of the content related to custom world generation has been removed.

The mod is natively compatible with the Witherstorm mod, and the Enchanted Command Block Book will be naturally generated in the basement of the Laboratory of the Order of the Stone.
